items.title: Awesome Integration
items.content_text:
### Projects / API Management

*   [Gravitee.io API Management (⭐380) (⭐376)](https://github.com/gravitee-io/gravitee-api-management) - A lightweight, open-source platform offering flexible API governance, robust security, and straightforward configuration.

### Projects / API Documentation

*   [Zudoku (⭐455) (⭐441)](https://github.com/zuplo/zudoku) - A customizable framework built on OpenAPI, focused on delivering exceptional developer experiences through quality documentation.

### Projects / API Gateway

*   [Envoy Gateway (⭐2.5k) (⭐2.5k)](https://github.com/envoyproxy/gateway) - CNCF Envoy-based gateway with Gateway API, mTLS, JWT, and other built-ins.
*   [Gloo Edge (⭐150) (⭐146)](https://github.com/solo-io/gloo) - An Envoy Proxy–based gateway offering advanced traffic control, enhanced security, and observability for microservices ecosystems.

### Projects / Data Mapping Solution

*   [JSLT (⭐689) (⭐683)](https://github.com/schibsted/jslt) - Powerful JSON query and transformation language inspired by jq and XPath, designed for rapid and flexible data manipulation.

### Projects / Message Broker

*   [Apache Artemis (⭐998) (⭐1k)](https://github.com/apache/artemis) - A multi-protocol message broker, supporting various industry standard protocols such as AMQP 1.0, MQTT 3.1.1, MQTT 5, and STOMP.

### Projects / Self-Service Integration

*   [n8n (⭐174k) (⭐172k)](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n) - Open-source workflow automation tool with 400+ connectors, giving you full control over your data and integrations.

### Resources / Data Formats

*   [YAML (⭐452) (⭐450)](https://github.com/yaml/yaml-spec) - A human-friendly and easy-to-read data serialization format that is widely used for configuration files and data exchange. It supports rich data types and is compatible with most programming languages.
